adoption.selection: Best screen candidate by primary metric then tie breaker; compare to independent reference.

holdout.policies: Selected candidate, independent reference, main reference
holdout.rule: No policy changes after holdout starts. Retain independent incumbent unless paired score improvement CI lower bound is positive; main replacement additionally needs positive paired improvement vs candidate on the same panel.

caveat: Available local opponents represent different production and market behaviors; this is not proof of performance against unseen strong public entrants.
